discharge_summary.hospital_course:
Patient came to the clinic with main complaints of fever and weakness today. He explains that the sudden high fever just started this morning, and goes up and down throughout the day with headache, body ache and joint pain. He mention no diarrhea but had a slight stomach cramps and feeling very nauseous. The patient has not been taking any medicine to reduce the symptom. He felt tired, weak and is losing appetite since this morning.

While undergoing treatment at the clinic, the patient experiences vomiting and diarrhea. He vomited just once, and had watery diarrhea followed by stomach cramps for 3 times in the past 6 hours. He was then given additional medicine.

As per this afternoon, the patient felt a lot better. There was no more diarrhea, stomach cramps, nor nausea and weakness. The patient is the discharged.
